description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class related to notification forwarding settings in an Android application. It tests the setting, persistence, disabling, and retrieval of quiet hours configuration, ensuring correct behavior and state management.

classes.name: SecurePrefsNotificationForwardingTest
classes.description: A test class that validates the notification forwarding quiet hours settings, including setting, persistence, disablement, and retrieval behaviors.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_rejectsInvalidDraftsWithoutMutatingStoredValues
methods.description: Tests that invalid quiet hours drafts are rejected without mutating the stored preferences.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_persistsValidDraftsAndEnabledState
methods.description: Verifies that valid quiet hours settings are correctly persisted and the enabled state is updated accordingly.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_disablesWithoutRevalidatingDrafts
methods.description: Ensures disabling quiet hours does not revalidate or alter existing valid drafts.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy_readsLatestQuietHoursImmediately
methods.description: Checks that the notification forwarding policy reflects the latest quiet hours settings immediately after update.

methods.name: notificationForwarding_defaultsDisabledForSaferPosture
methods.description: Validates that notification forwarding is disabled by default for safer posture.
